description: A chromatic pitch pipe — tap any note from C to B across two octaves to hear a pure reference tone for tuning and singing.

faqs.a: Two full octaves, C4 to B5, at A=440Hz concert pitch.
A pure sine wave — the cleanest reference for matching pitch by ear.
faqs.q: What does the tone sound like?

faqs.a: Tap a note to play it; tap again (or Stop) to silence it. Hold mode sustains while pressed.
faqs.q: How do I play a note?

faqs.a: Yes — works on desktop and mobile browsers.

howto: Tap any note button to hear its pitch.
Use the octave shift for higher or lower ranges.
Match the tone by ear to tune or warm up.
Tap Stop to silence a sustaining note.
title: Pitch Pipe Tool
